TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Postpartum return to light activity and progressive strength/conditioning with restrictions: no heavy lifting, no abs, no jumping, gradually increasing load with walking and bodyweight work"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Reintroduction and mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          glute_bridge 3x12
          bodyweight_squat 3x12
          incline_push_up 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Stability and light loading":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          hooklying_pz 0
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 60 seconds
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Core awareness and posture":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          dead_bug 3x8..12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12
          side_plank 3x15s per side
        cooldown:
          thread_the_needle 60 seconds
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 30m "Mobility and light compound patterns":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          chair_dip_assisted 3x8..12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          bodyweight_step_up 3x10 per leg
          lat_pulldown (assisted, using resistance band anchored) 3x10
        cooldown:
          child_pose 60 seconds

  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Stability plus light resistance":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:

          incline_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          dumbbell_row (light) 3x10 per side
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_flexor_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 35m "Controlled loading increase":
        warmup:
          walking 6 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          leg_extension 3x12
          leg_curl 3x12
          shoulder_press 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
        cooldown:
          spinal_twist 60 seconds

      DAY Monday training 35m "Core and posture basics with legs":

    WEEK 11:

    WEEK 12:

NUTRITION PLAN (breastfeeding support)
  GOAL: Support milk production, energy for training, and recovery with adequate calories and nutrient-dense foods.

  GUIDELINES
    - Calorie target: slight surplus from estimated maintenance to support lactation and activity; aim ~250–350 kcal/day above maintenance, adjusted by hunger, weight trends, and clinician guidance.
    - Macronutrient distribution: protein 1.6–2.0 g/kg bodyweight per day; fats 0.8–1.0 g/kg; carbohydrates fill remaining calories.
    - Hydration: 2.3–3.0 liters of fluid per day, more with activity and heat; include water with meals and during workouts.
    - Protein sources: lean poultry, fish, eggs, dairy, legumes, tofu, tempeh; include a protein source with every meal.
    - Fat intake: emphasis on healthy fats (avocado, nuts, olive oil, fatty fish 2–3x/week if allowed).
    - Micronutrients: ensure adequate iron, calcium, vitamin D, DHA (through fish or supplement as advised), and B12 as per dietary pattern; consider prenatal vitamin if continuing postnatally unless otherwise directed.
    - Iron: monitor fatigue; consume iron-rich foods (red meat, lentils, spinach) with vitamin C for absorption; consider supplementation if advised by clinician.
    - Caffeine: limit to moderate levels; 200–300 mg/day; some infants are sensitive.
    - Alcohol: avoid or minimize; if chosen, wait 2–3 hours after breastfeeding and limit quantity.

  SAMPLE DAILY FRAME (adjust portions to meet energy target)
    - Breakfast: 2 eggs or plant-based alternative, 1–2 slices whole grain toast, 1 cup yogurt or fortified plant milk, fruit; optional smoothie with protein, spinach, berries, chia.
    - Snack: Greek yogurt or dairy-free yogurt with nuts and berries.
    - Lunch: grilled chicken or tofu salad with mixed greens, quinoa or brown rice, avocado, olive oil-based dressing.
    - Snack: apple with almond butter; or hummus with vegetables.
    - Dinner: salmon or tempeh, sweet potato, steamed vegetables, lentil or chickpea side.
    - Evening: casein-rich snack if hunger before bed (cottage cheese or soy alternative) to support overnight recovery and milk supply.
    - Pre/post-workout: small carbohydrate-protein snack (banana with peanut butter, yogurt with fruit) to support performance and recovery.

  Special considerations
    - If experiencing breast fullness/engorgement, adjust fluid and sodium as advised by clinician; avoid overly restrictive dieting.
    - Weight goals: gradual and patient; focus on energy, training adherence, and infant well-being over rapid changes.
    - Medical clearance: continue to follow OB guidance; pause or adjust plan if any pain, bleeding, or signs of overexertion occur.

  MONITORING
    - Track energy, appetite, milk supply (subjective), sleep, and mood.
    - Reassess monthly with clinician; adjust calories and macros accordingly.
